issues.description: Users say many features or basic use now require Premium, making the free version feel too limited.
Most examples object to how much the app pushes Premium or restricts free use, but a few express general app sentiment or praise instead.
Most examples describe poor customer service without identifying a specific failure, while one praises support.
Most examples report difficulty reaching support or getting useful help, though a few provide unrelated or positive support experiences.
issues.issue_name: Difficulty reaching or getting help from support

issues.description: Examples describe mixed support experiences, including delayed or ineffective responses as well as prompt or successful help.
